scenes.description: Harrison Wood, a 21-year-old college student, is frantically pacing near the ticket counter at Reno Airport. His flight back to Orange County has been canceled due to weather delays, and the airport staff are informing him that last-minute changes are not possible without additional fees. His friends, Gang and Henry, are nearby at a gate, calmly discussing alternative plans. Tension is rising as Harrison’s anxiety grows.

actions.dialogue: Look, I didn’t have time to book in advance. My professor’s class starts tomorrow, and I can’t afford to miss it. Is there any way to get on a later flight without paying more?
I understand, but our system requires advance booking for last-minute changes. You might have to wait for a new flight or find another way to Orange County.

actions.action: Calling Harrison over to the gate
actions.dialogue: Hey, Harrison! Come over here. Henry found a bus route to Sacramento with a connecting flight. It might be a longer trip, but it’s cheaper than waiting here for a last-minute ticket.
A bus to Sacramento? That could work, but it’s going to add hours to the trip. I need to get back to campus as soon as possible.
I know it’s not ideal, but it’s the only option without paying a ton more. We can leave tonight and split the cost. It’s better than sitting here and waiting for something that might not happen.
I just... I wanted to be responsible and make it on time. But I guess I didn’t plan this right. Maybe I should take the bus. I can study on the way.
If you’re open to it, there’s a flight to Las Vegas later this evening. From there, you could take a connecting flight to Orange County. It’s a bit of a detour, but it might be faster than the bus.
Wait, Las Vegas? That’s wild. But if it gets you back to class faster, I’m all for it.
Okay, let’s go with the Las Vegas flight. I need to get back in time for class, and I can’t afford to wait. Thanks for the help, everyone.
I’ll help you book the flight and figure out the rest. Don’t worry, we’ll make it work.

scenes.plot: Harrison is stranded at Reno Airport after his flight home is canceled. He argues with airport staff about last-minute options but is met with resistance. His friends Gang and Henry suggest alternative plans, including a bus to Sacramento and a detour via Las Vegas. Harrison weighs his options and decides to take the Las Vegas flight to ensure he returns to school on time. The group works together to adjust their plans.
scenes.social_purpose: Show how Harrison’s values of responsibility and time management clash with his anxiety and the need to compromise in a group setting. Highlight the dynamics of group decision-making and the role of each character’s personality in shaping the outcome.
